61600.meaning1: because of taking refuge in the Saṅgha

61617.meaning1: having torn through; having ripped apart; having burst through

61621.grammar: pr, caus of saṃ pa √vatt, trans (+acc)
61621.commentary: (ANa) sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ saṃbandhāya sampavattentī'ti piyo piyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paveṇiyā bandhan'atthaṃ saṃvāsaṃ pavattayanti.

examples.text: pubbe sudaṃ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ n'eva kiṇanti no vikkiṇanti, sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ saṃbandhāya saṃpavattenti. eta'r'ahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ kiṇantipi vikkiṇantipi, sampiyenapi saṃvāsaṃ saṃbandhāya saṃpavattenti.

61623.meaning1: at the request; at the behest (of)
61623.commentary: (SNa) dārehi saṃpuccha gharā nikkhāmentī'ti sabbaṃ mama santakaṃ gahetvā mayhaṃ niddhanabhāvaṃ ñatvā attano bhariyāhi saddhiṃ mantayitvā maṃ gharā nikkaḍḍhāpenti.

examples.text: idha me, bho gotama, cattāro puttā. te maṃ dārehi saṃpuccha gharā nikkhāmentī'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imā gāthāyo pariyāpuṇitvā sabhāyaṃ mahājanakāye sannipatite puttesu ca sannisinnesu bhāsassu

61624.meaning1: to ask; to inquire; to question (somebody about)
61624.commentary: (MNa) saṃpucchituṃ āgacchantī'ti khattiyapaṇḍit'ādayo c'eva brāhmaṇagandhabb'ādayo ca pañhe abhisaṅkharitvā pucchissāmā'ti āgacchanti. tattha keci pucchāya vā dosaṃ vissajjanasampaṭicchane vā asamatthataṃ sallakkhetvā apucchitvā'va tuṇhī nisīdanti, keci pucchanti, kesañci bhagavā pucchāya ussāhaṃ janetvā vissajjeti. evaṃ sabbesam'pi tesaṃ vimatiyo tīraṃ patvā mahāsamuddassa ūmiyo viya bhagavantaṃ patvā'va bhijjanti.

examples.text: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadā saṃpucchituṃ āgacchanti
vuṭṭhamhi deve caturaṅgule tiṇe, saṃpupphite meghanibhamhi kānane, nag'antare viṭapisamo sayissaṃ, taṃ me mudū hehiti tūlasannibhaṃ.

61627.meaning1: gives precedence (to); esteems; holds in high regard

examples.text: atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, addhā kho kāpaṭikassa māṇavassa tevijjake pāvacane kathā bhavissati. tathā hi naṃ brāhmaṇā saṃpurekkharontī'ti.

61628.commentary: (MNa) āmakacchinno'ti atitaruṇakāle chinno, so hi vāt'ātapena saṃphusati c'eva milāyati ca.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena saṃphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.
evam'eva tuvaṃ māra, āsajja naṃ tathāgataṃ, sayaṃ ḍahissasi attānaṃ, bālo aggiṃ'va saṃphusaṃ.

61631.commentary: (ANa) sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ saṃbandhāya sampavattentī'ti piyo piyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paveṇiyā bandhan'atthaṃ saṃvāsaṃ pavattayanti.

examples.text: pubbe sudaṃ, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ n'eva kiṇanti no vikkiṇanti, sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ saṃbandhāya saṃpavattenti. eta'r'ahi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇiṃ kiṇanti'pi vikkiṇanti'pi, sampiyena'pi saṃvāsaṃ saṃbandhāya saṃpavattenti.
puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā apasādetā hoti, kiṃ pan'āyaṃ sambahul'ājīvo sabbaṃ saṃbhakkheti.

61633.meaning1: (of rivers) confluence; junction; place where rivers meet
61633.commentary: (SNa) saṃbhejja-udakan'ti aññāhi nadīhi saddhiṃ sambhinnaṭṭhāne udakaṃ. (SNt) sambhijjati missībhāvaṃ gacchati etthā'ti sambhejjaṃ, missitaṭṭhānaṃ. tattha udakaṃ sambhejja-udakaṃ. ten'āha sambhinnaṭṭhāne udakan'ti.

examples.text: etadeva, bhante, bahutaraṃ, yadidaṃ, saṃbhejja-udakaṃ, appamattakāni dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni ubbhatāni. saṅkham'pi na upenti, upanidham'pi na upenti, kalabhāgam'pi na upenti saṃbhejja-udakaṃ upanidhāya dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni ubbhatānī'ti.

61634.meaning1: water of the confluence; water where rivers meet

examples.text: etadeva, bhante, bahutaraṃ, yadidaṃ, saṃbhejja-udakaṃ, appamattakāni dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni ubbhatāni. saṅkham'pi na upenti, upanidham'pi na upenti, kalabhāgam'pi na upenti saṃbhejja-udakaṃ upanidhāya dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni ubbhatānī'ti.

61635.meaning1: face to face (with); in front (of); present

examples.text: dissanti c'eva suyyanti cā'ti ye saṃmukhā te passanti, ye tiro'kkhā te suṇanti.
hatthasaṃyato pādasaṃyato, vācāsaṃyato saṃyat'uttamo, ajjhattarato samāhito, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.

61638.meaning2: state of self-control; fact of self-restraint

examples.text: yo ca jānaṃ saṃyat'atto, jānaṃ na bahu bhāsati, sa munī monam'arahati, sa munī monam'ajjhagā'ti.

61640.commentary: (SNa) na mano saṃyatattam'āgatan'ti… mano saṃyatattaṃ āgataṃ, yaṃ mano yattha saṃyatabhāvaṃ āgataṃ, dānaṃ dassāmi, sīlaṃ rakkhissāmī'ti-ādinā nayena uppannaṃ, etaṃ mano na nivāretabbaṃ, añña'd'atthu brūhetabbaṃ vaḍḍhetabbaṃ.

examples.text: na sabbato mano nivāraye, na mano saṃyatattam'āgataṃ, yato yato ca pāpakaṃ, tato tato mano nivāraye'ti.

atha kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavato padāni anugacchanto addasa bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ sant'indriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttama-damatha-samatham'anuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ saṃyat'indriyaṃ nāgaṃ.

61643.commentary: (KHPa) madanīy'aṭṭhena majjaṃ, majjassa pānaṃ majjapānaṃ, tato majjapānā. saṃyamanaṃ saṃyamo

examples.text: āratī viratī pāpā, majjapānā ca saṃyamo, appamādo ca dhammesu, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
yamhi saccañ'ca dhammo ca, ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo, sa ve vantamalo dhīro, thero iti pavuccatī'ti.

61644.commentary: (MNa) saṃyamenā'ti sīlasaṃyamena. (SNa) pāṇesu'pi sādhu saṃyamo'ti pāṇesu saṃyatabhāvo'pi bhaddako.

examples.text: sādhu kho, mārisa, dānaṃ, appakasmim'pi sāhu dānaṃ. saddhāya'pi sāhu dānaṃ, dhammaladdhass'āpi sāhu dānaṃ. viceyya dānam'pi sāhu dānaṃ, api ca pāṇesu'pi sādhu saṃyamo.
dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena atthi puññaṃ, atthi puññassa āgamo'ti.

61645.meaning1: restrains; holds back; controls; keeps in check (someone wrt)
61645.commentary: (SNa) saṃyamāmase'ti saṃyamāma saṃyatā homa. iminā pāṇ'ātipātā virati gahitā, dutiyapadena musāvādā virati, tatiyapadena sesā tisso viratiyo.

examples.text: pāṇesu ca saṃyamāmase, sampajānamusā na bhaṇāmase, sikkhema susīlyamattano, api muccema pisācayoniyā'ti.
attā hi attano nātho, attā hi attano gati, tasmā saṃyamam'attānaṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃ'va vāṇijo.
attā hi attano nātho, attā hi attano gati, tasmā saṃyamay'attānaṃ, assaṃ bhadraṃ'va vāṇijo.
dūraṅ'gamaṃ ekacaraṃ, asarīraṃ guh'āsayaṃ, ye cittaṃ saṃyamessanti, mokkhanti mārabandhanā.

saṃyācikā + a

61657.commentary: (MNt) sārāgā saṃyujjantī'ti bahalarāgahetu yath'ārahaṃ dasahi'pi saṃyojanehi saṃyujjanti.

catucakkaṃ navadvāraṃ, puṇṇaṃ lobhena saṃyutaṃ, paṅkajātaṃ mahāvīra, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.
ujuko nāma so maggo, abhayā nāma sā disā, ratho akūjano nāma, dhammacakkehi saṃyuto.

examples.text: pañcakāmaguṇike rāge pariññāte n'atthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto ariyasāvako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyya
imamhi ce, bhikkhave, samaye uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo kālaṅ'kareyya, n'atthi saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyā'ti.
surā nāma piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā.

61663.commentary: (MNa) mahatā atthena saṃyutto agamissā'ti mahatā atthena saṃyutto hutvā gato bhaveyya, sot'āpattiphalaṃ pāpuṇeyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, pesso hatth'ārohaputto muhuttaṃ nisīdeyya yāvass'āhaṃ ime cattāro puggale vitthārena vibhajissāmi, mahatā atthena saṃyutto abhavissa.

61665.meaning1: Book 3 of the Sutta Piṭaka; Connected Discourses
61665.commentary: (DNa) katamo saṃyuttanikāyo? devatāsaṃyutt'ādi-vasena kathitāni oghataraṇ'ādīni satta suttasahassāni satta ca suttasatāni dvāsaṭṭhi ca suttāni.

examples.text: bhāsitam'p'etaṃ, mahārāja, saṃyuttanikāyavare māṇavagāmikena devaputtena bhagavato purato ṭhatvā devamanussamajjhe
sabbam'eva c'etaṃ dīghanikāyo, majjhimanikāyo, saṃyuttanikāyo, aṅg'uttaranikāyo, khuddakanikāyo'ti pañcappabhedaṃ hoti.

61673.meaning1: having collected together; having formed a ball

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, balavā puriso jivh'agge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saṃyūhitvā appakasirena vameyya
kadā saṃyūḷhā pana te, pañcasikha, imā gāthā buddh'ūpasañhitā dhamm'ūpasañhitā saṅgh'ūpasañhitā arahant'ūpasañhitā kām'ūpasañhitā'ti?
jaheyya sabbasaṃyogaṃ, kareyya saraṇ'attano, careyy'ādittasīso'va, patthayaṃ accutaṃ padan'ti.
saṃyogāya saṃvattanti no visaṃyogāya

ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, n'atthi sabbaso bhavanirodho'ti, tesam'ayaṃ diṭṭhi sārāgāya santike, saṃyogāya santike, abhinandanāya santike, ajjhosānāya santike, upādānāya santike.
saṃyogato pubbe eo rassā iv'occante kvaci, anantarā byañjanā saṃyogo.

61680.meaning1: with association as the best; as the highest combination
61680.commentary: (SNa) saṃyogaparamā tv'eva, sambhogā sabbapāṇinan'ti pārivāsikaodan'ādīni hi asambhog'ārahāni honti, tāni puna uṇhāpetvā bhajjitvā sappimadhuphāṇit'ādīhi saṃyojitāni sambhog'ārahāni honti. ten'āha saṃyogaparamā tv'eva, sambhogā sabbapāṇinan'ti

examples.text: sabbe sattā atthajātā, tattha tattha yath'ārahaṃ, saṃyogaparamā tv'eva, sambhogā sabbapāṇinaṃ, nipphannasobhano attho, verocanavaco idan'ti.

61682.meaning1: fetter; chain; bond; thing which binds
61682.commentary: (THa) saṃyojanan'ti vaṭṭadukkhena saddhiṃ santānaṃ saṃyojanato vaṭṭe osīdāpanasamatthaṃ dasavidham'pi saṃyojanaṃ. (SNa) kiṃ su saṃyojano'ti kiṃ saṃyojano kiṃ bandhano?

examples.text: appamādarato bhikkhu, pamāde bhayadassi vā, saṃyojanaṃ aṇuṃ thūlaṃ, ḍahaṃ aggī'va gacchati.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhāvan'ānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato appakasiren'eva saṃyojanāni paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavantī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, āneñj'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye lok'āmisasaṃyojane se pavutte.

61684.meaning1: with a fetter; having a chain; about a bond; regarding a thing which binds

examples.text: kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññā vimutto'ti?

61685.meaning1: wearing away the chains; slow destruction of the bonds

examples.text: tesaṃ phassaparetānaṃ, bhavasot'ānusārinaṃ, kummaggapaṭipannānaṃ, ārā saṃyojanakkhayo.

61687.meaning1: abandoning the bonds; removing the fetters

examples.text: imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañc'indriyāni bhāvitāni bahulīkatāni saṃyojanappahānāya saṃvattantī'ti.

61688.meaningLit: for the sake of abandoning the fetters

saṃyojana + pahāna + attha + aṃ
saṃyojanappahānattha + aṃ

examples.text: sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kim'atthiyaṃ, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha, saṃyojanappahān'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti

61690.meaningLit: group of six discourses starting with the discourse on abandoning the fetters
61690.sanskrit: saṃyojana + prahāṇa + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + ṣaṭka, ṣaṭtva

61691.meaning1: who has cut the chains and ropes; (or) which severs the fetters and bonds

examples.text: catubbipallāsavasaṃ adhiṭṭhitaṃ, gāmaṇḍalaṃ'va parinesi citta maṃ, nanu saṃyojanabandhanacchidaṃ, saṃsevase kāruṇikaṃ mahāmuniṃ.

61692.meaningLit: discourse on the eradication of the fetters
